title: With a both-direction relationship a filter on Customer reaches Product through Sales

source.quote: The product slicer now lists a single option: T-shirt
source.supports: the page uses these rows and states that, sliced by Australia with the Product relationship set to both directions, only T-shirt remains

source.quote: it also propagates from the many-side to the one-side
source.supports: a both-direction relationship also propagates from the many side to the one side

derivation: Australia is CUST-02. Sales rows of CUST-02: row 3 (CL-01). Sales[SKU] -> Product[SKU] filters both ways, so Product is filtered to CL-01, the T-shirt. There are no orphan Sales rows, so no blank row.
